purpose: Test the previously selected, frozen B1 trend comparator on a later period and additional assets without retuning.

data.source: Binance public spot monthly 15m candle archives with publisher SHA256 checksums
data.selection: Fixed purposive sample of BTC/ETH plus SOL/XRP/BNB chosen before price access. This is not a point-in-time reconstructed universe; survival/selection bias remains.
data.novelty: 2026 and additional coins were not loaded in the preceding two research experiments. Prior access elsewhere in this application is unknown; not claimed pristine or prospective.
data.missing_data_policy: Fail affected cohort visibly; no forward-fill, replacement coin or outcome-dependent date changes. Warm-up only precedes start.

risk: Unchanged: 0.25% per trade, 0.5% aggregate risk, 50% gross notional, two positions, three entries per UTC day, 1% daily/3% weekly/5% drawdown circuit breakers; no leverage.
independence: Cohorts have separate hypothetical wallets. Results are not summed into one investable return. Stress scenarios overlap and are not independent trades or evidence.
analysis: Keep all six trials, asset attribution, marked daily returns, first-failure gates and stop reviews. Report descriptive weekly-block uncertainty, no causal news labels. Stress reruns admission, so populations differ.
decision: No deployment even if numerical gates pass: execution/universe data, dependence/selection-aware inference and prospective paper evidence remain required. No substitutions, retuning, pooled stress sample or 80% claim. Loading this period consumes it as validation evidence; it cannot be reused as unseen.
